text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up: Nimbus Analytics wants an on-prem POC. Asking to waive the platform/on-prem fee for the 90-day POC and to have reduced support charges during the trial. No upfront onboarding invoice if possible.
Maya Gupta: Who is leading the technical POC? any signal they'll convert after POC?
Alex Chen: I'm owning it. They expect to move to reserved capacity if latency & cost checks out. Proposal I'm floating: waive platform fee (~$20,000/mo) for 3 months; 12mo reserved commit afterwards at list $65k/mo with a 10% commit discount to $58.5k/mo. Onboarding one-time fee we put at $15k but they pushed back. Support: normally $7k/mo (Gold), propose temporary POC support at $3.5k/mo.
Erin Lee: Technical notes: on-prem requires private control plane + KMS integration + SSO. Engineering estimate ~3 engineer-weeks for install + KMS testing. Acceptance criteria: perf <= 1.3x hosted median latency, KV cache working for top-10 prefixes, SSO SAML flow validated. KMS/HSM approvals may add ~2 additional weeks.
Noah (Deal Desk): Need commercial justification and ARR/backstop for any platform fee concession. We cannot approve a full write-off without either (a) LOI/payment commitment, (b) refundable deposit, or (c) exec email + clear conversion timeline. Numbers please (ARR sensitivity and margin impact).
Alex Chen: Commercial math: waiver = -$60k revenue impact over 3mo. If they sign the 12mo at $58.5k/mo, net first-year revenue (incl. commit minus concession) ~ $662k. Asking for the waiver to remove friction for on-prem install sign-off.
Chris Patel: Finance: -$60k is material for a mid-market deal. We can entertain a waiver if there's a guaranteed conversion mechanism. Minimal acceptable ARR to justify waiver: $700k ARR or strong exec-level commitment. Also need to know whether onboarding hours are billable or absorbed.
Alex Chen: Customer won't pay onboarding up-front. They're offering an exec confirmation email + LOI to commit to terms immediately post-POC. Suggested LOI terms: 12mo reserved @ $58.5k/mo, LOI signed within 10 business days of acceptance, no-shop, and retro-bill clause if they don't convert.
Noah (Deal Desk): That conditional LOI approach can work. Conditions: (1) LOI + exec email sent within 10 business days of acceptance, (2) finance places a billing hold flag in SFDC during POC, (3) LOI must include explicit payment obligation or refundable deposit clause, (4) retro-invoicing clause if LOI not executed in time. I'll mark as provisional approval once we have draft LOI text and finance OK.
Chris Patel: Finance OK in principle, but retro-billing requires legal to sign off on the wording and we need to tag the account as an exception in the revenue system. If LOI fails to arrive, we'll invoice the platform fee for POC months and flag collectability.
Legal Bot: Required items to proceed: updated LOI template with retro-invoicing clause, no-shop clause, and payment obligation language; POC SOW that includes acceptance tests and KMS/HSM responsibilities; on-prem indemnity and data handling language. I'll circulate a LOI + SOW skeleton after this thread.
Erin Lee: Draft SOW snippet for acceptance (dropping here):
```
Acceptance Criteria:
- Median request latency <= 1.3x hosted baseline for 95th percentile
- KV cache functioning for top-10 query prefixes
- SAML-based SSO validated end-to-end
- KMS integration validated with sample key rotation
```
I'll also attach the KMS checklist for infra to validate cert timelines.
Alex Chen: I'll draft the LOI with the retro-bill clause and a short commercial justification for the deal memo. Proposed commercial blurb: "Nimbus Analytics - strategic mid-market analytics partner. Platform fee concession to remove on-prem friction; conditional on LOI + exec email within 10 business days and retro-bill protection on non-conversion. Expected conversion to 12mo reserved commit at $58.5k/mo."
Maya Gupta: If LOI comes in, I'll schedule the 3-week eng block and allocate the SRE window for install. Note: if KMS/HSM delays push installation beyond the 90-day POC window, we need an amendment clause.
Noah (Deal Desk): Please record the conditional approval: waive platform fee for up to 90 days conditional on LOI+exec email within 10 business days, billing hold in SFDC, and LOI containing payment/refund clause. If conditions not met, retro-invoice platform fee for POC months. Once Alex drops the LOI draft I'll finalize. :white_check_mark:
Chris Patel: Keep finance in the loop. If LOI is >10 business days late we'll auto-enable billing and invoice retroactively.
Alex Chen: Update: customer exec said they can provide the exec email the week of 2026-05-18 and are reviewing LOI draft. I'll post LOI draft here when ready. Thanks all. :pray:
Maya Gupta: Will stand-up the install calendar once LOI confirmed.
Noah (Deal Desk): Marking as pending; will convert to approved when LOI+exec email are in.
Alex Chen: Noted. I'll follow up with the draft LOI and attach it to the SFDC opp.
Chris Patel: Sounds good. Keep the finance tags on the opp so we can track recognition.
Legal Bot: I'll prepare LOI template and SOW, will ping when uploaded.
Alex Chen: Closing loop for now ":thumbsup:"
